_comment: Curated Michigan property-tax statute corpus. This is the SINGLE provenance universe for the assessment explainer: AI-off renders these as citation links; AI-on may cite ONLY from this list (the model narrates, never originates). PROVISIONAL (A1/A7a): mirrors the prose corpus _MI_TAX_STATUTES in map-buddy/backend/agent.py — until A6/A7a converge them, the two MUST be kept in sync. URLs target the Michigan Legislature MCL viewer (state: 'resolves' when a clean section anchor exists, else 'coarse').

statutes.name: General Property Tax Act
statutes.plain: The framework for assessing and taxing real property in Michigan.

statutes.name: Assessment at 50% of True Cash Value
statutes.citation: Mich. Const. Art. IX, Sec. 3; MCL 211.27a
statutes.plain: Assessed Value (AV) is half of a property's True Cash (market) Value.

statutes.name: State Equalized Value (SEV) & equalization
statutes.plain: County and state equalization confirm assessments sit uniformly at the 50% level; SEV is AV after equalization.

statutes.name: Taxable Value cap (Proposal A)
statutes.plain: A property's Taxable Value (TV) rises each year by the lesser of 5% or the inflation rate multiplier (CPI), until ownership transfers.

statutes.name: Uncapping on transfer of ownership
statutes.plain: The year after a transfer, TV resets ('uncaps') to that year's SEV.

statutes.name: Principal Residence Exemption (PRE)
statutes.plain: Exempts an owner-occupied principal residence from up to 18 mills of local school operating tax.

statutes.name: Property classification
statutes.plain: The assessor assigns each parcel an STC class (agricultural, commercial, industrial, residential, timber-cutover, developmental).

statutes.name: March Board of Review
statutes.plain: The first level of appeal for assessment, taxable value, or classification disputes.

statutes.name: Michigan Tax Tribunal
statutes.plain: Appeals beyond the Board of Review; residential/agricultural appeals follow the Board of Review, commercial/industrial may go directly by May 31.
